# HyperSVG

> Turn an SVG into a hyper drawing: parts that respond, with behavior in plain JSON and no program code. Pack it as
> a HyperSVG (one .svg file for a web page) or an Experience (one offline .html page). npm package: @hypersvg/core.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): the starter lamp in five steps
- [GUIDE](GUIDE.md): every JSON word and drawing mark, each with an example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): the rules for coding agents
- [Skill](skills/hypersvg/SKILL.md): the HyperSVG skill for coding agents (init also puts it in .claude/skills/hypersvg/)

## More

- [Examples](docs/guide/examples/): lamp, harbour, ad, list
- [Embedding](docs/browser-embedding.md): HyperSVGs in a web page
- [Extending](EXTENDING.md): components and add-ons
- [Specification](spec/2.0/README.md): the full format
